description: The response time of an HTTP request to a given url, tagged by url, for example 'url:http://example.com'. Also tagged by http_outcome with the HTTP status code of the response when enable_http_outcome_tag is set.

Whether the check can connect, 1 if true, 0 otherwise. Tagged by url, for example 'url:http://example.com'. Also tagged by http_outcome when enable_http_outcome_tag is set, with the HTTP status code of the response or the reason no response is received.

Whether the check failed to connect, 1 if true, 0 otherwise. Tagged by url, for example 'url:http://example.com'. Also tagged by http_outcome when enable_http_outcome_tag is set, with the HTTP status code of the response or the reason no response is received.
